listing.name: Oddish's Crash Logger
listing.summary: This is just an extra crash information logger that I vibecoded for debugging another mod's development. I have since deleted the code as it was quite useless, but then later on claude told me that it actually WAS useful. I'm putting it up here as a mod if anyone wants to use it. It saves way more information about the game, mostly for LLM's to understand what went wrong. It's just an enormous dump of whatever I can dump, pretty much.
listing.aiSummary: Logs extensive game state and error details to a text file for debugging purposes.

description: Captures a large amount of information about the game when a crash occurs. The resulting log is designed to be analyzed by large-context LLMs to help identify the cause of the issue.
